product.name: Dual Shared Board
product.oneSentence: Extend an existing board with page-aware WebMCP and page-independent MCP adapters over one canonical operation map.
audience: People and automation clients collaborating on one durable board
product.sharedArtifact: The durable board record, revision stream, visible page selection, and audit receipts.

humanWorkflow.visibleFeedback: The page reconciles durable revisions and displays its page-only item selection.

state.persistenceLocation: The existing board domain store represented by the executable fixture.

capabilities.userJourney: Inspect the visible board or its durable record through the appropriate surface.

ui.humanEntrypoint: Read the open board list and revision.

resultContract.summary: Return board identity, durable items, and revision.

successEvidence: Both adapters return the same board ID, items, and revision.

capabilities.userJourney: Add an item through the page or service without overwriting a newer revision.

ui.humanEntrypoint: Submit the existing board add-item form.
ui.visibleEffect: The visible board reconciles the committed item and durable revision.

resultContract.summary: Return the committed item, durable revision, and commit ID.

successEvidence: A WebMCP commit is readable through MCP at the same revision.
An MCP commit is reconciled into the visible page revision.

capabilities.userJourney: Select an item only in the currently open board page.

ui.humanEntrypoint: Select an item in the board list.
ui.visibleEffect: The matching item becomes the visible page selection without changing durable board state.

resultContract.summary: Return the selected item ID and current durable revision.

successEvidence: The returned item ID matches the visible page selection.
